verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs describe a built-in Agents API where AI agents 'autonomously execute tasks using LLMs, with tools, state persistence, and multi-agent collaboration' and support 'Agents Handoffs' for seamless task delegation between agents, backed by built-in tools (code interpreter, web search, document library/RAG, image generation) and MCP integration. This directly matches the story of delegating tasks to a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specifically of the agent-delegation experience (community evidence in the pack concerns model quality/OCR accuracy, not the Agents/Le Chat delegation workflow), and no evidence of real-world outcomes or failure modes for the agentic handoff feature.
